title: Writing and Transformation Workflow
summary: Use AI to transform material while preserving meaning, voice, evidence, privacy, and reviewability.
objectives: Prepare a writing brief with audience, purpose, source of truth, and acceptance criteria.
Separate content transformation from unsupported factual creation.
Verify meaning, evidence, voice, accessibility, and disclosure.
Recover from drift, invented details, and inappropriate handling of source material.

sections.title: Prepare the writing brief
paragraphs: Name the audience, purpose, channel, tone, length, source of truth, facts that must remain exact, and review owner. code.label: Transformation brief
code.code:
Audience and purpose: [WHO AND WHY]
Transformation: [SUMMARIZE, RESTRUCTURE, TRANSLATE, EDIT, DRAFT]
Source of truth: [MATERIAL]
Must preserve: [FACTS, TERMS, QUOTES, VOICE]
Must change: [STRUCTURE, LENGTH, READING LEVEL]
Must not add: [UNSUPPORTED DETAILS]
Verify: [MEANING, EVIDENCE, ACCESSIBILITY, APPROVAL]

sections.title: Execute in visible passes

sections.title: Recover from drift and invention
paragraphs: When the draft changes meaning, return to the exact source passage, restate the preservation rule, and regenerate only the affected section. activity.title: Transform and audit a source passage
instructions: Choose a permitted 300–500 word source and define audience, purpose, transformation type, preservation rules, and prohibited additions.
Create a transformed version in two visible passes: source facts and structure, then audience-ready prose.
Audit exact facts, meaning, evidence, accessibility, attribution, and sensitive data.
Introduce one deliberate drift error, detect it with the audit, and document the correction.
evidence: A completed transformation brief, two-pass draft, and source-to-output audit.
A correction record showing the drift error, root cause, fix, and reviewer.
activity.reflectionPrompt: Which sentence sounded better after transformation but no longer meant the same thing?

cues.text: Build a brief that distinguishes transformation type, exact material to preserve, and unsupported additions.
Show source material passing through fact extraction, constrained transformation, and human review.
cues.accessibilityAlternative: A text flow reads: permitted source, exact facts and terms, constrained transformation, comparison review, approved output. Reduced-motion mode shows all stages.

cues.text: Demonstrate separate extraction and transformation passes with proposed additions visibly labeled.
Ask learners to mark one sentence that must remain exact and one that may change freely.
Allow ninety seconds to define preservation rules.
Compare facts, meaning, evidence, audience fit, and accessibility against the source and brief.
Correct one drifted section without regenerating and destabilizing the entire document.
Review privacy, attribution, copyright, impersonation, and generated quotation risks.
Check that learners can prove one transformed claim still matches its source.
Guide the two-pass transformation, audit, deliberate drift, and correction record.
Begin the check after the learner has verified meaning, evidence, permission, and audience fit.

questions.prompt: What should a transformation brief identify first?
choices: The audience, purpose, transformation type, source of truth, preservation rules, and review
questions.explanation: These fields define what may change, what must remain exact, and how acceptance is judged.

questions.prompt: Why use separate extraction and transformation passes?
choices: To distinguish source-derived facts from rewriting and proposed additions
questions.explanation: Visible passes make factual preservation and unsupported additions easier to review.

questions.prompt: A plain-language rewrite changes a legal obligation. What should happen?
choices: Keep it because it is easier to read
Return to the source, correct the affected section, and obtain responsible review
questions.explanation: Readability cannot override exact meaning in consequential text.

questions.prompt: Which practice best protects sensitive source material?
choices: Ask the model not to remember it
Minimize and redact data, confirm permission, and use approved handling
questions.explanation: Data minimization and authorized handling reduce exposure before generation occurs.

questions.prompt: What makes a transformation correction reproducible?
choices: A record of source version, brief version, detected drift, fix, and reviewer
questions.explanation: Versioned source, instructions, change, and review evidence allow the decision to be reconstructed.
